sections.Profile:
The "Band Wagon" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 16, 1955, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Festival, Marching Band
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Harry Williams
